patch_description: Inspired by the highly successful coordinate descent approach from a prior program, this algorithm upgrades the control-point basis to a multi-scale model (fine, coarse, and global Gaussian bumps). This allows the path to make broad base-oriented bends while preserving sharp local school avoidance. It perfectly aligns the proxy score with the true multiplicative objective (F1 * F2 * F3) and uses a robust grid-search initialization to explore different path topologies. Finally, it applies an optimized, non-cumulative coordinate descent to fine-tune the control points and find the global minimum smoothly and efficiently.
